text_block_list.name: Monthly Twinkle Article
text_block_list.text:
"On this day, our 'dream' spread its wings
and soared high into the sky over Hanshin Racecourse."

text_block_list.name: Monthly Twinkle Article
text_block_list.text:
""We look up, yearning for the glory that awaits ahead.
Her victory... No. Our—""

text_block_list.name: Monthly Twinkle Article
text_block_list.text: "At that night's Winning Live, the crowd erupted in thunderous cheers for <chrname>, who took first place."

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
That was a great victory! You can do it overseas, too!
Become the best in the world!! Good luck――...

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: ...Go get 'em, <chrname>! I'll be watching over you always! Cheering you on!

text_block_list.name: Monthly Twinkle Article
text_block_list.text:
"Did you hear it? Could you hear it?
The voices of the people here."

text_block_list.name: Monthly Twinkle Article
text_block_list.text:
"‘The voices cheering you on.
The voices of everyone wanting to see you through.’"

text_block_list.name: Monthly Twinkle Article
text_block_list.text:
"Spread your wings and take flight into the open sky.
—Our 'Dream.'"
Reporting & Editorial: Etsuko Otonashi

text_block_list.name: Campus Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone in Project L'Arc!
Assemble in the gymnasium immediately!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days had passed since the Takarazuka Kinen...
An announcement from Chairwoman Akikawa echoed throughout the academy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And alongside <chrname>,
I head for our destination. This time, to the venue of
the National Representative Match to decide Japan's representative.
